title: Chapter 144 Progress Of Catapults
content:
Chapter 144 Progress Of Catapults

"Lord City Lord, I wonder if there is anything else you need to buy next?" Hadro did not leave immediately. Now Wang Shuo's purchasing potential can be further stimulated.

Wang Shuo thought for a while.

"Is there any more of the thunder that shook the sky last time?" Wang Shuo showed a longing look in his eyes.

"Sorry, there are none for the time being." Hadro shrugged, then he seemed to remember something, took out a drawing, smiled and said: "But I also have a drawing of 'Passing a Yang Bow with a Hundred Steps' here. This The biggest feature of this strong bow is that it uses simple materials and is slightly more powerful than an ordinary sophisticated longbow."

[Hundred Steps Penetrating Yang Bow: Excellent level weapon, attack power +30, agility +8, durability 80/80, a common standard weapon in the army. 】

Wang Shuo looked at the attributes and found that they were indeed much stronger than ordinary bows and arrows.

He nodded, showed a smile and said: "Not bad, I want this thing."

This thing was not too precious at the moment, so Wang Shuo bought it for only 1,000 gold coins.

Because Hadro arrived in a hurry, he did not prepare other good things. After the two agreed on the items they wanted to trade next time, Hadro left Wang Shuo's territory.

Wang Shuo found Matar and handed him the drawing.

"Mr. Matar, after you finish the work at hand, you can make more hard bows like this." Wang Shuo warned, and when he saw the busy figures of the blacksmiths, Wang Shuo showed curiosity.

After seeing Wang Shuo's expression, Matar explained: "Lord, some of us are working hard to make bronze ballistas, and some of us are studying accessories for light catapults."

"Um, have you made any progress?" Wang Shuo knelt down and touched a black thing with his hand.

Matar called a craftsman over and said to Wang Shuo: "Lord, this is a new and proud disciple I have recently acquired, named Udon. Next, let him introduce this situation to you!"

"Meet the lord!" Udon solemnly saluted Wang Shuo.

Wang Shuo raised his head and looked at the young man. His eyes were alert. The cotton-padded jacket on his body was unbuttoned, and his hands were covered with calluses. On one of his hands, there was an obvious wound that had not healed yet. It was obviously a recent injury.

Udon took a deep breath, adjusted his breathing, and explained to Wang Shuo: "We have achieved a lot in the past two days."

"The metal accessories of trebuchets are not used much. We can basically make them. We are currently studying the ammunition used by trebuchets, because this ammunition is not stones, but projectiles with special materials such as saltpeter added. After you go there, there will be an explosion, and the damage will be amazing. "

Wang Shuo's eyes were filled with surprise and uncertainty. An explosion could actually occur. This...

Very nice!

"Where did your saltpeter come from?" Wang Shuo didn't remember that he had this thing!

"My master asked for this from General Manager Duan. General Manager Duan gave me some from the previously seized materials, but the quantity was a little small, so there were not many projectiles that could be produced."

When Wang Shuo heard this, he shouted in his heart, this is not possible, the more of this kind of thing, the better!

"Don't worry, I'll find a solution for the saltpeter." Wang Shuo patted Udon on the shoulder and gave him reassurance.

Udon's eyes sparkled with surprise, and it was obvious that he liked this kind of research very much.

After Wang Shuo walked out of the blacksmith shop, he was thoughtful.

Hadro has already left, and it seems that we can only wait until the next time he comes.

Or you can go to Lao Zhao's to have a look, or go to Nanshan Market to buy. There are quite a lot of options to choose from.
